title: daniellia pilosa
intro: Daniellia pilosa, commonly known as African butter tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Daniellia pilosa include its use as a natural remedy for treating various ailments, such as fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Daniellia pilosa include its ability to exhibit analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential treatment for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Daniellia pilosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
